question:
Match List-I (Name of the composition) with List-II (Writer).

 
 

 
 
**List - I (Name of the Composition)**

 
 
 
**List - II (Writer)**

 
 
 

 
 
1.

 
 
 
Vande Mataram

 
 
 
A.

 
 
 
Pradeep

 
 
 

 
 
2.

 
 
 
Jana Gana Mana

 
 
 
B.

 
 
 
Bankim Chandra Chattopadhyay

 
 
 

 
 
3.

 
 
 
Ae Mere Watan Ke Logon

 
 
 
C.

 
 
 
Rabindranath Tagore
solution:
The correct answer is __**Option 3**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Vande Mataram** was written by **Bankim Chandra Chattopadhyay**.
 
• **Jana Gana Mana** was written by **Rabindranath Tagore**.
 
• **Ae Mere Watan Ke Logon** was written by **Pradeep**.
 
• The correct matching is:
 
 
• 1 - B
 
• 2 - C
 
• 3 - A
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Vande Mataram** is a hymn to the motherland and played a vital role in the Indian independence movement.
 
• **Jana Gana Mana** is the national anthem of India, adopted on January 24, 1950.
 
• **Ae Mere Watan Ke Logon** is a patriotic song commemorating the soldiers who died during the Sino-Indian War.
